notes.title: Play The Jackbox Survey Scramble Today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948640/The_Jackbox_Survey_Scramble/

Jackbox has made an all-new party experience! Taking real surveys from real people around the globe, The Jackbox Survey Scramble is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Invite your friends, family, coworkers, and enemies to see how they think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?”

Multiple New Game Modes
 Hilo: Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! It turns out a lot of people named their cat Frank. That's a freebie.
 Speed: In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher! Can you handle it?
 Squares: Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares. We guarantee, you've never had a more heated argument over attractive fictional characters than you will playing Squares.
 Bounce: In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! But be careful! The ball gets faster with each answer!
But wait… there’s more! We’ll be releasing a free game update featuring two new game modes in a couple months 👀 So what are you waiting for? Get The Jackbox Survey Scramble now for just $9.99 USD.



Play with your phone or tablet - no special controller required. All games support 2 to 8 players and 10,000 audience members. All Jackbox Survey Scramble games can be played in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian or Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. And we'll be making sure we have localized answers for the UK and Australia, as well.

notes.title: The Jackbox Party Starter - Now Localized for Brazilian Portuguese!
notes.content:
Your copy of The Jackbox Party Starter just got a bit more cultured. We’ve just launched a free update to all three games to include a Brazilian Portuguese language option. The Jackbox Party Pack 10 was our first foray into localizing content for the Brazilian market, and today we’re so excited to launch three more of our most popular titles in Portuguese! 

Why did we do this? We want to make our games as accessible as possible to fans from all over the world. Our Brazilian fans have asked for more games available in Portuguese, and we are gladly obliging. Earlier this year we also launched social media profiles in Portuguese to better accommodate Brazilian audiences. 

https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1755580/extras/Q3_steam.gif?t=1686249736

Will we update more of our back catalog to be available in other languages? Not at this moment. Creating these language patches is more than just running scripts through Google Translate and copying and pasting the results. It’s much, much more than that. We take all of the in-game content and hire localization experts in the region to emulate the irreverent tone that makes Jackbox so special. Then we hire local voice actors and adapt the game art, theme songs, and every other in-game detail to give fans a seamless experience in other languages. We also add in completely new content that’s geared for the region. For example, you’d likely see questions about Brazilian football teams rather than American football teams. All of this takes time to do, but we are always working to make our games available to fans around the world.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2466364192779532268/F28DE4BB4823A0572F110F2407155A00989DEB00/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

There are fifteen games available in French, Italian, German, Castilian Spanish and Latin American Spanish. Titles in bold are also available in Portuguese:

 The Jackbox Party Pack 9: Roomerang, Junktopia, Nonsensory, Fibbage 4
 The Jackbox Party Pack 10: Hypnotorious, Tee K.O. 2, Timejinx, Fixy Text, Dodo Re Mi

notes.title: The Jackbox Decade Bundle Is Out Now
notes.content:
Wow! Ten years of Party Packs! So much has happened during this past decade, and none of it has been vaguely apocalyptic, right? . . . RIGHT??

The Jackbox Decade Bundle is great for anyone looking to guarantee they’ll never have to deal with figuring out what to do with friends again, or as a gift to ensure your loved one is set for every party for the rest of their lives.

https://shop.jackboxgames.com/cdn/shop/files/19_PP10_TKO2-0030_Upscaled_1024x1024@2x.png?v=1712185770

What is the Jackbox Decade Bundle?

We are celebrating ten years of party games by releasing all of our Party Pack titles into one big bundle! That’s right! 50 games from Party Packs 1-10 for one low price of $199.99!

Play fan favorites like Quiplash, Trivia Murder Party, and Tee K.O. with your grandma! Or some hidden gems like Job Job, Role Models, or Monster Seeking Monster with that one coworker who smells like corn chips! The possibilities are truly endless!

https://shop.jackboxgames.com/cdn/shop/files/laptop_quiplash_1024x1024@2x.jpg?v=1712185770

Where can I buy the Jackbox Decade Bundle?

The Jackbox Decade Bundle is available on Sony consoles, Microsoft consoles, Nintendo Switch, and Steam. Only one player needs to own the bundle for everyone else to join together in the room or over video conferencing apps. And the best part is, with Jackbox Games, your phone is the controller, so there’s no special equipment required! Already own all our games? You’re amazing. The Jackbox Decade Bundle makes a great gift as well. 

Buy now!

Note for international:
The Jackbox Party Bundle includes all Party Packs. Only The Jackbox Party Pack 9 and The Jackbox Party Pack 10 are available fully translated to French, Italian, German, Spanish and/or Portuguese.

notes.title: All Five Games Coming to The Jackbox Party Pack 10 - Wishlist Today!
notes.content:
Wishlist The Jackbox Party Pack 10 today!
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33030169/2a7724727936241d9b55be3bf07d6784393a95a7.png

--- 

We’ve almost made another trip around the sun since The Jackbox Party Pack 9 was released and it’s time to dust off your space boots and get ready for the launch of The Jackbox Party Pack 10! A brand new pack of 5 party games is set to arrive this fall and blast your parties into another hilarious dimension.

The Jackbox Party Pack 10 will be available at launch in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian Spanish, and Latin American Spanish. These games are perfect for your family holidays, game nights with friends, work happy hour, or to play alongside your favorite streamer.

Here are the 5 games in The Jackbox Party Pack 10:

Tee K.O 2

(Drawing, Writing): In Tee K.O. 2, return to T-Shirt Island, where the most hardened warriors in the world compete in a deadly fighting tournament. The drawing finger – not the fist – decides the victory! Tee K.O. 2 supports 3-8 players. Read this to learn more or watch the trailer and first look video with RubberRoss below:
[previewyoutube=gF_MLy6b5gg;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=egOQAaUylUc;full][/previewyoutube]

FixyText

(Writing, Teamwork): FixyText is the Wild West of text-editing. In this chaotic game, everyone’s in a group chat, typing all at once to make the most memorable statement. And there’s no delete key. Take that auto-correct! FixyText supports 3-8 players. Read this to learn more or watch the trailer and first look video with Outside Xbox below.
[previewyoutube=71Q0fzMiwCg;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=B0hyCEdSKfo;full][/previewyoutube]

Hypnotorious

(Hidden Identity, Roleplaying): Hypnotorious is a game with secret roles, tentative alliances and of course, silly answers to ridiculous questions. Who is on your side? Hypnotorious supports 4-8 players. Read this to learn more or watch the trailer below.
[previewyoutube=IUgQezHhHk8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=6rA-y7XLFys;full][/previewyoutube]

Timejinx

(Trivia): In Timejinx, you’re a time traveler from the future competing in a high-stakes trivia night. Save your current timeline by answering questions about the past. Timejinx supports 1-8 players. Read this to learn more or watch the trailer below.
[previewyoutube=8uDGDc3_a2A;full][/previewyoutube]

Dodo Re Mi

(Music, Teamwork): In Dodo Re Mi, your phone is your instrument. You and your flock must make music together to escape the hungry jungle plant. Dodo Re Mi supports 1-9 players. Read this to learn more or watch the trailer below.
[previewyoutube=u-hHxjJEUM0;full][/previewyoutube]

The Jackbox Party Pack 10 is coming to major platforms later this fall. Follow us on social media for updates on more early looks at gameplay and for an official release date announcement. You can find us on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok!

notes.title: Celebrate the launch of The Jackbox Party Pack 9 with sales on all our games!
notes.content:
Shop the sale!


The Jackbox Party Pack 9 is here! Plan your launch party or Halloweekend with some brand new party games from Jackbox. The Jackbox Party Pack 9 is 10% off through 10/27 and all Jackbox Games titles are on sale for up to 60% off through 11/3. Complete your Jackbox party game collection now! 

The Jackbox Party Pack 9 contains 5 new games to liven up your next game night:

Fibbage 4 (2-8 players) - The hilarious bluffing party game returns with an all-new Final Fibbage, video questions, fan-submitted questions, and Fibbage Enough About You mode! It’s a game so beloved that we decided to slap a 4 on it. 

Quixort (1-10 players) - In this trivia sorting factory, work with your team to sort falling answers into their proper order before they hit the floor! Or, play the single-player mode and see how many blocks you can sort before topping out. It’s as easy as A, C, B!

Junktopia (3-8 players) - A strange wizard has turned you into a frog! Create hilarious backstories for weird objects and then get them appraised. The player with the most valuable items becomes human again! 

Nonsensory (3-8 players) - Professor Nanners is here to test your NSP (Nonsensory Perception) in this drawing, writing, and guessing game! How close can you get to guessing where another player’s prompt ranks on the silliest of scales? 

Roomerang (4-9 players) - Channel your inner reality TV star in an attempt to come out on top! Respond to prompts, bring the competition and role-play to avoid being voted out. Never fear though, even when you’re out you’ll find yourself Roomerang-ed right back into the drama!

Plus, an all-new kick players feature and the ability to connect to games via QR code!
